title: Best Trash Can (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on products mentioned in at least two of the cited sources (Consumer Reports, TechGearLab, BonAppetit, Reviewed).
assumptions: Prices are omitted unless explicitly stated in a source; only the listed prices are used.

verdict.line: Picture a busy kitchen where a sturdy, odor‑tight bin keeps food scraps contained. The Amazon Basics 13.2‑gallon can locks in odors and is priced about half of comparable models, making it a solid choice for most households. Its main catch is that it lacks a built‑in step or sensor feature.
